text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kualiti Alam Sekeliling

(Pewakilan Kuasa) (Penyiasatan ke atas Kawalan Hakisan dan Kelodakan) 2012.

Pewakilan Kuasa

2. Ketua Pengarah mewakilkan kuasa di bawah seksyen 31, 37, 38 (kecuali kuasa

untuk menahan, menaiki dan menggeledah mana-mana kapal atau pesawat udara)

dan 38A Akta berkenaan dengan kawalan kehakisan dan kelodakan bagi aktiviti yang

ditetapkan di bawah seksyen 34A Akta kepada pegawai yang memegang jawatan yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Mana-mana Juruteknik, Penolong Jurutera dan Jurutera di Jabatan Pengairan dan

Saliran Malaysia.

Dibuat 23 Oktober 2012

[AS(S)91/110/919/014 sk 2; PN(PU2)280/XIV]

HALIMAH BT HASSAN

Ketua Pengarah Kualiti Alam Sekeliling

ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT 1974

ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY (DELEGATION OF POWERS)

(INVESTIGATION ON EROSION AND SEDIMENT CONTROL) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 49(1) of the Environmental Quality

Act 1974 [Act 127], the Director General makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Environmental Quality (Delegation of

Powers) (Investigation on Erosion and Sediment Control) Order 2012.

Delegation of power

2. The Director General delegates the powers under sections 31, 37, 38 (except the

power to stop, board and search any ship or aircraft) and 38A of the Act in respect of

erosion and sediment control of prescribed activity under section 34A of the Act to

officers specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Any Technician, Assistant Engineer and Engineer of the Department of Irrigation and

Drainage Malaysia.

Made 23 October 2012

[AS(S)91/110/919/014 sk 2; PN(PU2)280/XIV]

HALIMAH BT HASSAN

Director General of Environmental Quality
